svg.title: Meridian Retail Group — Figure 3 — Unity Catalog object model
svg.text: Unity Catalog object model: catalogs, schemas, groups and policy
one catalog per environment, one schema per domain-and-layer · grants to groups at schema level · governed tags drive ABAC, not per-table masks (§5.5, §6.4 · D-05, D-06)
deployed automatically on merge to main
Git branch validation · no cluster overrides
BRONZE · one schema per source · platform team writes, ingestion pipelines only
SILVER · one schema per domain · the owning domain's pipeline writes
GOLD · the published data products · analysts, applications, partners, agents read
ML AND PLATFORM · governed, not project-local
VOLUMES · the governed alternative to mount paths and shared buckets
GROUP TAXONOMY — account groups, never workspace-local
FOUR GRANT RULES — applied without exception
HOW A GRANT FLOWS — and the cross-domain rule
— explicit, recorded agreement — it couples release cycles
GOVERNED TAGS — defined at account level
tag applied by the pipeline that creates it
D-05 · catalog per environment, schema per domain — the rejected alternatives
D-06 · ABAC on tags, not per-table masks — why it scales
The workspace is a working environment; Unity Catalog is the security boundary. Workspaces are allocated for operational and residency reasons only (§5.7).
